content.text: {"improvements":[{"id":"IMP-001","description":"Replace the remaining `jq` canonicalization claim in the Audit Envelope Library dependency list with explicit RFC 8785 JCS tooling (`lib/jcs.sh`, `rfc8785`, `canonicalize`) and state that `jq` is non-canonical only.","rationale":"The current line in §1.4.1 (`jq` as canonical-JSON dependency) contradicts the v1.4 JCS-only policy and can reintroduce signature/hash divergence in implementation.","location":"§1.4.1 Shared Cross-Cutting Infrastructure → Audit Envelope Library → Dependencies","priority":"HIGH","confidence":0.98},{"id":"IMP-002","description":"Unify the L4 trust-ledger canonical file path across the document (choose either `.run/trust-ledger.jsonl` or `grimoires/loa/trust-ledger.jsonl`) and update all diagrams, APIs, backup policy, and failure-mode text accordingly.","rationale":"Conflicting storage paths create operational ambiguity for signing, backup, restore, and chain verification, risking data loss or false integrity failures.","location":"§1.3 Component Diagram; §1.4.2 L4; §1.7.1; §3.2.2; §3.7","priority":"HIGH","confidence":0.97},{"id":"IMP-003","description":"Add an explicit two-stage validation contract for `audit_emit`: validate unsigned envelope fields first, then sign, then validate full signed envelope schema (or define separate pre-sign and post-sign schemas).","rationale":"Current flow validates before signature while schema requires `signature` and `signing_key_id`, which is logically inconsistent and implementation-blocking.","location":"§1.4.1 Audit Envelope responsibilities; §1.5.1 Audit Log Write Path; §3.2.1 envelope required fields","priority":"HIGH","confidence":0.95},{"id":"IMP-004","description":"Standardize non-interactive configuration failure semantics by mapping `EX_CONFIG (78)` into the formal error taxonomy and exit-code matrix, including caller handling expectations.","rationale":"The SDD currently uses both custom code `7` and POSIX `78` for configuration errors; inconsistent contracts can cause CI/cron misclassification and silent retries.","location":"§1.7 non-interactive fail modes; §6.1 Error Categories","priority":"HIGH","confidence":0.96},{"id":"IMP-005","description":"Correct the versioning statement that implies all State Zone files are git-tracked and align it with the explicit tracked/untracked matrix.","rationale":"The current statement is factually inconsistent with `.run/*` untracked logs and can mislead recovery planning and audit retention assumptions.","location":"§3.1 Storage Technology (“since all State Zone files are tracked”) vs §3.7 Persistence policy","priority":"MEDIUM","confidence":0.94},{"id":"IMP-006","description":"Resolve the single-machine enforcement loophole by either including L3 writes in machine-fingerprint enforcement or documenting why L3 cross-host writes are safe under signature-chain and schedule semantics.","rationale":"Current guardrails exempt L3 despite global single-machine scope; this creates policy inconsistency and potential cross-host drift for cycle logs.","location":"§1.7.1 Hard Runtime Guardrails (“Not affected: L3”)","priority":"MEDIUM","confidence":0.86},{"id":"IMP-007","description":"Add concurrency-safe cache write semantics for L5 (temp-write+atomic-rename and optional lock per repo cache file).","rationale":"L5 is labeled read-only/no flock, but it mutates cache files; concurrent invocations can produce torn JSON and stale/invalid cache reads.","location":"§1.4.2 L5 responsibilities and dependencies; §3.6 Caching Strategy","priority":"MEDIUM","confidence":0.9},{"id":"IMP-008","description":"Fix SLO reference drift by placing write-path latency targets in a dedicated section and updating all cross-references (including Sprint 1 benchmark acceptance criteria) to that exact section.","rationale":"Current references point to §6.4 for SLOs, but §6.4 is logging strategy; this weakens acceptance-gate enforceability and review traceability.","location":"Sprint 1 AC additions (SKP-004); §6.4; §7.1; changelog references to IMP-005","priority":"MEDIUM","confidence":0.92}],"summary":"8 improvements identified, 4 HIGH priority"}
